stableKeyDerivation.rationale: This reproduces the exact stableId input used by scripts/pantavion-canonical-knowledge-excavation-v2.cjs, preserving the original canonical identity derivation while retaining the full SHA-256 source fingerprint.

compactPointerSemantics: Each listed integer is the zero-based record index inside the immutable batch file for a record owned by that bucket. Record payloads and IDs are not duplicated here.
